summary: Tested the AI privacy warning, Consent Trend and Privacy Notice in preview. Backend regression passed: 66/66 (test_ai_notice, test_consent_trend, test_privacy_consent, test_comm_builder_batch). Frontend: most flows pass. There is 1 HIGH bug: inside the Court Ordered chat dialog (Radix CourtDialog) the AI notice and confirm pop-ups cannot be clicked, focus and Escape go to the dialog behind, so a user cannot accept the notice or answer the confirm from the court chat dialog. There is 1 MEDIUM bug: on the Landing page (/legacy) Coach demo, a signed-out visitor never sees the 'Before you continue' consent screen and the AI pop-up does not open by itself. Minor gaps are listed below.

minor.issue: Signed-out first-visit 'Just so we're on the same page' modal POSTs and gets 401. The UI still continues, but the request is noisy.

ui_bugs.component: CourtChatPanel inside CourtDialog (Radix Dialog, court-ai-fab -> court-chat)
ui_bugs.issue: The AiNoticeModal and AiConfirmModal are portaled to document.body. The Radix modal Dialog sets body pointer-events:none, and .sa-ai-modal inherits 'none', so clicks fall through to court-chat (Playwright: 'court-chat-ai-banner ... subtree intercepts pointer events'). ai-notice-agree, ai-notice-continue, ai-confirm-edit and ai-confirm-send-anyway cannot be clicked. Radix FocusScope keeps focus in the court dialog: on open, focus is on court-chat-close and Tab goes to court-chat-prompt-0, so the TrapModal trap does not work. Escape closes the Court dialog (Radix document capture listener), not the AI pop-up, and the pop-up stays open over the page. Result: a user cannot accept the AI notice or answer the confirm dialog from the court chat dialog.

Signed-out visitor taps coach-demo-empty-input -> POST /api/auth/guest 200, then nothing happens: no consent screen and no AI pop-up. '/legacy' is in ConsentGate OPEN_PATHS, so the consent screen never renders, user.consent_current stays false and the provider's afterGuest effect never opens the notice. A second tap opens the AI notice directly, and the guest can accept it (POST /ai-notice/ack 200) and use AI without ever passing 'Before you continue'. The '/' portal flow (door-comm -> cb-draft-input) works correctly: guest -> consent screen -> AI pop-up opens by itself.

action_items: HIGH: Make the AI notice and confirm modals usable when opened from a Radix modal Dialog (CourtDialog / court-chat). Options: (a) add pointer-events:auto to .sa-ai-modal; (b) expose noticeOpen||confirm from AiNoticeProvider and render CourtDialog with modal={!aiModalOpen}, or add onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside/onFocusOutside handlers that call preventDefault when the target is inside .sa-ai-modal, plus onEscapeKeyDown preventDefault while an AI modal is open. Radix FocusScope also steals focus, so modal={false} while the AI modal is open is the simplest fix. Check the same for any other shadcn/Radix Dialog that holds an AI input.

MEDIUM: Landing /legacy Coach demo signed out: either remove /legacy from ConsentGate OPEN_PATHS for guest sessions, or in AiNoticeProvider.openNotice show the consent screen (or navigate to a gated route) when user.consent_current is false. Also block openNotice/ack for users without consent_current so the AI pop-up cannot be accepted before 'Before you continue'.
LOW: Add an AiNoticeNeeded prompt for Parallel Parenting step tips before ack.
LOW: Show 'fewer than 5' in a visible column at 390px; consider a sticky Continue in the AI modal on mobile.
Verify: the Privacy Notice shows only sections 1, 2, 7 and 12 (no 3-6 or 8-11). Confirm this matches the user's exact pasted text.
critical_code_review_comments: AiNoticeProvider.ack(): no catch, so a failed POST /ai-notice/ack gives an unhandled rejection with no error message in the modal.
TrapModal's keydown handler is on the overlay div. If focus is outside it (e.g. Radix steals it), neither the trap nor Escape works. A document-level capture listener while open would be more robust.
AiNoticeProvider.openNotice for guests relies on the consent gate showing. It breaks on any OPEN_PATHS page (/legacy, /watch, /for-professionals...) that hosts an AI input.
aiNoticeChecks: phone needs separators (2105551234 is not flagged); 'specific date' misses written dates like 'March 3rd'. Acceptable per spec, but worth noting.

rca of the issue: Court chat: Radix Dialog (modal) sets body{pointer-events:none} and runs FocusScope + DismissableLayer. The AI modals are createPortal(document.body) siblings outside the Radix layer, so they inherit pointer-events:none, can't hold focus, and Escape goes to Radix's document capture listener first. Repro: parent1 unacked -> / -> door-court -> court-ai-fab -> click court-chat-input -> ai-notice-modal shows but ai-notice-agree can't be clicked. /legacy: ConsentGate OPEN_PATHS has '/legacy', so the consent screen is skipped for the new guest; the afterGuestRef effect waits for consent_current, which never becomes true.
